import ast, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from tools import scan_anti_regression_gate as gate
ROOT=Path.cwd()
BASE="d4589d77"
def git_paths(args):
    return set(subprocess.check_output(["git",*args,"-z"]).decode("utf-8").split("\0"))-{""}
base_paths=git_paths(["ls-tree","-r","--name-only",BASE])
tracked=git_paths(["ls-files","-c"])
untracked=git_paths(["ls-files","-o","--exclude-standard"])
current=tracked|untracked
candidates=sorted(p for p in current-base_paths if p.endswith(".py") and (ROOT/p).is_file())
tests=[p for p in candidates if gate.is_collected_test_path(p)]
sources=[p for p in candidates if gate.is_production_source_path(p)]
parse_errors=[]
valid=[]
for p in tests:
    try:
        ast.parse((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=p)
    except (SyntaxError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        parse_errors.append({"path":p,"error":str(exc)})
    else:
        valid.append(p)
missing_fn=gate.scan_missing_test_function(str(ROOT),valid)
missing_doc=gate.scan_missing_docstring(str(ROOT),valid)
details={}
for p in sorted(set(missing_fn+missing_doc)):
    raw=(ROOT/p).read_bytes()
    tree=ast.parse(raw.decode("utf-8"),filename=p)
    details[p]={"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"line_count":len(raw.splitlines()),"tracked":p in tracked,
                "untracked":p in untracked,"docstring":ast.get_docstring(tree),
                "top_definitions":[{"name":n.name,"line":n.lineno,"kind":type(n).__name__} for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))],
                "imports":[{"module":n.module,"names":[{"name":a.name,"asname":a.asname} for a in n.names],"line":n.lineno} for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)],
                "has_main_guard":any(isinstance(n,ast.If) and "__name__" in ast.dump(n.test) and "__main__" in ast.dump(n.test) for n in tree.body)}
result={"baseline":BASE,"baseline_commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse",BASE],text=True).strip(),
        "scope":"All present git-visible tracked or untracked Python candidate paths minus baseline path set; no Git changes and no dependency on rename heuristics",
        "baseline_path_count":len(base_paths),"tracked_path_count":len(tracked),"untracked_path_count":len(untracked),
        "candidate_python_count":len(candidates),"candidate_test_name_count":len(tests),"candidate_product_count":len(sources),
        "candidates":candidates,"test_candidates":tests,"product_candidates":sources,"parse_errors":parse_errors,
        "missing_test_function":missing_fn,"missing_docstring":missing_doc,"uncovered_source":gate.scan_uncovered_source(sources,gate.load_scope_globs()),"details":details}
path=Path('/tmp/aps-task-h-integration-20260910.l7JCYN/prospective-complete-details.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ("candidates","test_candidates","product_candidates","details")},ensure_ascii=False))
print("DETAILS "+str(path))
sys.exit(1 if parse_errors or missing_fn or missing_doc or result["uncovered_source"] else 0)
